spec.title: LLM Overview
spec.description: Start here: requests, spend, tokens, latency and errors of every LLM call that Claude Platform and OpenRouter traced.

panels.title: Requests
panels.description: LLM API calls in the time range: Claude Messages API requests plus OpenRouter generations. Grafana Cloud runs a TraceQL metrics query over 25 hours at most, so keep the time range at 24 hours or less.

panels.title: Spend
panels.description: Claude spend is estimated from tokens at standard Claude API list prices (prices.json, read on 2026-10-14); batch, priority-tier and negotiated discounts are not applied. OpenRouter spend is the cost OpenRouter billed.

panels.title: Tokens
panels.description: Input plus output tokens. Input includes prompt-cache reads and writes.

panels.title: Claude cache hit rate
panels.description: Share of Claude input tokens read from the prompt cache. A cache read costs a tenth of input or less, so higher is cheaper. Long agent sessions usually stay above 80%. Covers the time range up to about 15 minutes ago.

panels.title: Error rate
panels.description: Share of calls whose span ended with an error status: rate limits, overloads, invalid requests, upstream failures. Covers the time range up to about 15 minutes ago.

panels.title: p95 latency
panels.description: 95% of calls finished faster than this, from request start to the last streamed token. Tempo buckets durations to powers of two, so read it as a range. Covers the time range up to about 15 minutes ago.

panels.title: Tokens by source
panels.description: Input plus output tokens in each time bucket. The legend total is the sum over the range.

panels.title: Spend over time
panels.description: Spend in each time bucket by model (claude-* models through Claude Platform, provider/model ids through OpenRouter). The legend total is the spend over the range. Claude spend is estimated from tokens at standard Claude API list prices (prices.json, read on 2026-10-14); batch, priority-tier and negotiated discounts are not applied. OpenRouter spend is the cost OpenRouter billed.

panels.title: Spend by model
panels.description: Spend over the time range for each model, largest first. Claude Haiku 5.5 prompts over 100K tokens pay five times the base rates; that extra has its own bar. Claude spend is estimated from tokens at standard Claude API list prices (prices.json, read on 2026-10-14); batch, priority-tier and negotiated discounts are not applied. OpenRouter spend is the cost OpenRouter billed.

panels.title: Latency p50 / p95
panels.description: Call duration percentiles by source. p50 is the median.

panels.title: Errors
panels.description: Failed calls by source and error type, for example rate_limit_error or overloaded_error. Empty is good.

panels.title: Requests by model
panels.description: Calls over the time range for each requested model.

panels.title: Tokens by model
panels.description: Input plus output tokens over the time range for each requested model.

panels.title: p95 latency by model
panels.description: 95th percentile call duration for each model over the time range. Covers the time range up to about 15 minutes ago.

panels.title: Latest LLM calls
panels.description: The most recent calls. Click a trace ID to open the whole trace.
